response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong TDD/craftsmanship practices, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/GIS platforms. He lacks demonstrated depth in Java/Kotlin, the Spring ecosystem, JVM internals, or IDE tooling — the core required qualifications for this role. Some Java exposure exists (robotics, National Instruments C IDE work) but it is peripheral and years old, not a current specialization.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across many languages and platforms (15+ years)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, workshops)
Prior experience building a C IDE (LabWindows/CVI) shows some relevant IDE tooling exposure
concerns: No current or recent experience with Java/Kotlin as primary languages
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java framework expertise
No JVM-specific or modern IDE internals experience; recent roles are TypeScript/Node-focused

key_factors.factor: No recent JVM or IDE tooling experience
Strong general software engineering craftsmanship and adaptability
